lines.zh: 我飘在半空，床单一样的身体下面没脚。
lines.en: I drift, no feet under this sheet of a body.
My hem trails over the grass tips.
I pass between the gravestones.
I sway as I drift.

lines.zh: 我绕过沼泽边上的枯树。
lines.en: I skirt the dead trees by the marsh.
I drift slowly your way.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在布下面若隐若现。
lines.en: My claws show and hide under the cloth.

lines.zh: 我飘过一片低矮的林地。
lines.en: I drift across a low wood.

lines.zh: 我身上的布被风吹起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts the cloth on me.
I make a loop and come back.
I drift out from behind the tree.
I drift low, almost on the ground.
I hang there, still.

lines.zh: 布下面什么都看不出来。
lines.en: Nothing shows under the cloth.
Only my eyes are solid.
My hem sways gently.

lines.zh: 我听见沼泽里的虫在叫。
lines.en: I hear insects in the marsh.
I forgot how to breathe long ago.
I'm counting what passes by.
The cloth on me is old.
I turn my head a little.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我飘高了一点。
lines.en: The wind comes and I rise a little.
I hover above a gravestone.

lines.zh: 我的布角被风掀起一点。
lines.en: A corner of my cloth lifts in the wind.
There's no light at all in the wood.

lines.zh: 我悬着，慢慢地翻了个面。
lines.en: I hang there and slowly turn over.
You see a sheet drifting.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶慢慢沉下来。
lines.en: I sink slowly down over your head.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在布下面发亮。
lines.en: My eyes glow under the cloth.

lines.zh: 那件东西，在你手里发白。
lines.en: That thing in your hand glows pale.
Don't lift the cloth.
I straighten my body slowly.
I'm half a head taller than you.
Will you go left, or right?
My claws show a little.
Back off and I'll drift away.
I lower my head close to you.
You don't smell dead.

lines.zh: 你握紧又松开，我都看着。
lines.en: I watch you clench and unclench your hand.
I watch every breath you take.

lines.zh: 这一个晚上我有很多时间。
lines.en: I have all night.
The marsh water is behind you.
Part of me scatters and re-forms.
A hole opens in my cloth.
I draw back half a foot and hover.

lines.zh: 我痛的时候，只有布在抖。
lines.en: When I hurt, only the cloth trembles.
Blackness seeps from the hole in the cloth.
I retract my claws.
I slowly steady myself.
I look down at the tear.

lines.zh: 布鼓起来，我比刚才更大。
lines.en: The cloth swells; I'm larger than before.
I can still drift like this.
That isn't even worth a taste.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，这东西对我无用。
lines.en: I have no mouth; this is useless to me.
I drift right past it.
Holding that won't keep me.
The smell drifts over to me.
I look down and don't stop.

lines.zh: 我用下摆把它拨到一旁。
lines.en: I sweep it aside with my hem.
Keep it; use it yourself.
I drift a little closer again.
I'm only curious about it.

lines.zh: 它在我脚下一点点凉下去。
lines.en: It cools at my feet, little by little.
I sweep it into the mud with my hem.
The cloth dents inward, then billows back.
The cloth flips up from the blow.
I've gathered myself again quickly.

lines.zh: 你打了个寒战，我已经在后头。
lines.en: You shiver; I'm already behind you.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的爪子弹了出来。
lines.en: That knocks my claws out.
I drift back half a foot.
The air goes cool for a moment.
I return to my old height.
I don't feel angry about it.

lines.zh: 我转过来的声音，是布响。
lines.en: The sound of me turning is cloth rustling.

lines.zh: 两块布在半空靠在一起。
lines.en: Two sheets come together in the air.
Her cloth is whiter than mine.
Our hems tangle once.
A corner of her cloth meets mine.
Neither of us needs to breathe.

lines.zh: 我们的眼睛同时亮了一下。
lines.en: Our eyes flare at the same moment.
She turns one circle around me.

lines.zh: 我们一起往沼泽那边飘。
lines.en: We drift toward the marsh together.
Her claws face mine.
She drifts off before I do.
One hook of a claw and it's mine.
It slips under the cloth.
I hold it under the cloth.
I don't quite understand this.

lines.zh: 举到眼前，我还是看不懂。
lines.en: Held up to the light, it still makes no sense.

lines.zh: 它从我的爪子中间掉下去。
lines.en: It falls through my claws.

lines.zh: 爪子伸出去，又缩回布下。
lines.en: My claw reaches out, then withdraws under the cloth.
I open my claws and let it fall back.

lines.zh: 隔着布，它凉得像块石头。
lines.en: Through the cloth it feels cold as stone.
I let go again.
I've seen it, and I don't blink.
I come down at you from above.
All my claws are out.
Two points of light rise under the cloth.
I'm speeding up now.
You run toward the marsh.
I follow along the wood's edge.
My hem sweeps the brush.

lines.zh: 你的汗味，比声音还清楚。
lines.en: Your sweat is clearer to me than sound.
You duck behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我从石头侧面绕过去了。
lines.en: I've gone round the side of the stone.
You look up; I'm already there.
I follow just under the treetops.
You're running for lower ground.
I pass over the marsh.
You shouldn't have come into this wood.
The damp off the ground lifts me.
I drop a little more.

lines.zh: 你数着脚步，我数着你的呼吸。
lines.en: You count your steps; I count your breaths.
I hold my claws to one side.
Your steps have already come apart.
I pass right at the back of your neck.
Your fist passes through the cloth and hits nothing.
A tear opens in the cloth.
Claw tips stab out through the seams.

lines.zh: 这一下撕开了你的肩膀。
lines.en: That tears your shoulder open.
I wrap my hem across your face.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，只打到布。
lines.en: You strike me and hit only cloth.
This time I go for the back of your neck.
My claws find bone.
You back off; I follow.
I hold you down so you can't rise.
You struggle beneath me.

lines.zh: 低下的不是头，是一团黑。
lines.en: What lowers isn't a head, but a mass of dark.
My eyes come very close.
That snap closes on air.

lines.zh: 我从坟边的雾里现出来。
lines.en: I take shape out of the mist by the graves.
An old sheet hangs over me.
I try lifting off first.

lines.zh: 我从林子的暗处浮出来。
lines.en: I float out of the dark of the woods.
The marsh's damp holds me up.
I light up my two eyes.
I drift above a gravestone.
Wind fills the cloth on me.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在林子里走。
lines.en: I hear someone walking in the wood.

lines.zh: 我背对你，又慢慢转回来。
lines.en: I turn away from you, then slowly turn back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从布下伸出来。
lines.en: My claws come out from under the cloth.
I drift that way.

lines.zh: 布被火燎到，我拍打着飞开。
lines.en: Fire catches the cloth and I beat it out, flying off.
I fall, and the cloth spreads out flat.
The marsh swallows me down.
The blast rips the cloth open.
Something sharp goes through the cloth.

lines.zh: 光一照，布下的轮廓全露了。
lines.en: In the light, every outline under the cloth shows.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西，可我也会淡。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago, and I can still fade.
The flash makes the cloth glow through.

lines.zh: 空得连风都没有，我飘着。
lines.en: It's so empty there's no wind; I drift.
